summary: Ryanair Holdings plc furnished a routine Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a foreign private issuer's current report) announcing total voting rights as at 31 October 2026. Issued share capital was 1,035,847,831 ordinary shares of EUR 0.006 nominal value, with no shares held in treasury, so total voting rights equal that figure. The disclosure satisfies Regulation 20 of the Irish Transparency Regulations 2007 and provides a denominator for shareholders' notification obligations. No transaction, stake, price, board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory clock is involved; this is administrative housekeeping with no risk-arb angle.
